business_summary: Sportradar Group AG (Nasdaq: SRAD) is a Switzerland-headquartered sports-data and betting-technology company. It holds two sourced roles on this chain, both from a June 2026 global partnership naming Kalshi directly: official-event-data (feeding official sports data and live odds) and market-surveillance-and-integrity (its UFDS AI and Integrity Exchange products).

exposure_summary.narrative: Sportradar holds two sourced roles on prediction-market-plumbing, both EMERGING and both resting on the same June 2026 Kalshi partnership announcement: official-event-data (chain position 1) and market-surveillance-and-integrity (position 3). FY2025 revenue grew to USD 1,290.0M (20.9% three-year CAGR) with net income of USD 100.3M and strong cash generation (operating cash flow USD 403.0M, FCF margin 30.9%). Piotroski, Beneish, operating margin, leverage, valuation and the reverse-DCF solve are all NULL this run: companyfacts does not report shares_fy (share count) or operating_income_fy for this filer, which blocks the denominators every one of those fields needs.
